title: Navimower 0.4.4-beta37

## Completed-zone coverage regression protection

This prerelease hardens per-zone coverage against a vendor-side recalculation observed after an unrelated map edit.

- Keep a zone at 100% in Home Assistant after a strictly confirmed vendor coverage completion when the same zone later reports a lower vendor percentage without evidence of a new mowing cycle.
- Protect only zones whose own local geometry and area still match the geometry captured for that confirmed completion; edits to the completed zone itself immediately disable the hold.
- Release the hold when a newer retained session or explicit per-zone cycle/reset boundary proves that mowing has actually started again in that zone.
- Preserve the lower raw vendor value separately as `vendor_coverage_pct` and expose `completion_hold`, `completion_hold_reason` and `completion_hold_vendor_pct` diagnostics instead of hiding the discrepancy.
- Recalculate map-level mowed area, map coverage and completed-zone count from the protected card-facing zone model.

## Upgrade behavior

- Existing verified completions gain a geometry fingerprint only while the vendor still re-affirms that zone at 100%; an already-regressed value is never adopted as the trusted baseline during upgrade.
- Polygon fingerprints are insensitive to start vertex and winding direction, so equivalent geometry serialization does not invalidate a completion.

## Regression coverage

- Add focused tests for the observed `100 -> 89` unchanged-zone case, genuine geometry edits, entry into a new mowing cycle and equivalent polygon point ordering.
- Existing monotonic `Last completed` semantics remain unchanged: fresh current-cycle per-zone vendor coverage is still the authority for creating a new completion.

## Mowing pause reason

- The existing `Mowing pause reason` sensor and its conservative low-battery/night/manual-dock attribution are unchanged in beta37. Low-battery remains automation-safe only after the vendor Device feed confirms the matching low-battery event.
